Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we kick off the POC: 

Recap (what we heard)
- Goal: Validate Redwood can reduce per-token cost by ~30% and meet 95th percentile latency < 250ms for customer-facing prompts in your payment reconciliation flow.
- Scope: 2 models (chat + reranker) on ~1M monthly tokens peak traffic simulated by Priya's test harness.
- Success criteria: latency, throughput, and output quality measured by your benchmark prompt set (will share).

Environment options we discussed:
1) Hosted trial (fastest): Redwood hosted sandbox with shared infra, quick to provision, lowest friction.
2) Dedicated sandbox: Reserved GPU pool in our environment for your trial — predictable performance and isolated capacity.
3) VPC trial (Private): Customer-managed VPC peering or on-prem connector; required for sensitive data/workloads but takes more setup time.

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Samir/Priya: confirm preferred trial environment (hosted vs dedicated vs VPC) and any compliance constraints.
- Priya: share the benchmark prompt set and sample traffic patterns (CSV) by EOD Friday.
- Aditya/Dev: draft a POC plan (roles, timeline, success criteria) and network requirements; propose target start date.

I've attached a one-page POC plan and a short network checklist for reference. If hosted works for you, we can provision sandbox access within 48 hours.

Thanks —
Marissa

Thanks Marissa — really helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Compliance: Our data is tokenized but we have strict egress rules. We prefer a VPC trial for any dataset with real identifiers. For initial functional validation, a hosted sandbox with synthetic data is acceptable.
- Success metrics: +1 on the latency/quality metrics. We'll add an SLA-like criteria for error rate (<0.5% unhandled failures) and end-to-end transaction time (including downstream DB writes).
- Ownership: Priya will own technical evaluation; I'll own procurement and executive sign-off.

Regarding timeline — we want to present a demo to the CTO on 2026-03-03. Ideally the POC runs for two weeks prior to that (target window 2026-02-16 to 2026-02-28). Can you confirm feasibility?

For environment: let's start with hosted sandbox for a quick smoke test next week, then move to a dedicated sandbox or VPC trial depending on results. Priya will send the prompt set and sample traffic tomorrow.

Hi Priya / Samir —

Thanks for the clear plan. A few technical notes on environment choice and what we need to move quickly: 

If you want fastest time-to-test (hosted sandbox):
- We can provision API keys and a tenant sandbox within 48 hours.
- We will only accept synthetic/test data in hosted to comply with your egress concern.
- We'll provide a pre-built synthetic dataset generator if helpful.

For a Dedicated sandbox (recommended for realistic perf numbers):
- Requires a short order for reserved GPU capacity (we can spin up within 3 business days after PO/commit).
- We'll coordinate IP allowlist + VPN options; requires network-team involvement on your side.

For VPC trial (private):
- Needs network peering or private endpoint setup; expect 5-10 business days depending on procurement/security reviews.
- We'll provide a network-requirements.xlsx (attached by Marissa) with ports and CIDR ranges.

Success/validation plan (proposal):
1) Week 0 (pre-work): share prompt set, traffic profile, and acceptance test definitions.
2) Week 1 (smoke): hosted sandbox — functional checks, output quality, basic latency profiling.
3) Week 2 (performance): dedicated sandbox — realistic load, KV cache priming, end-to-end latency.
4) Acceptance: measure against agreed SLA metrics and sample-quality checks (we suggest 200 sample prompts reviewed by your SME).

Ownership:
- Redwood SEs (Aditya/Dev) to provision environments and run joint perf runs.
- FinTechCo (Priya) to provide prompt set, traffic generator, and SME for quality checks.
- Marissa to coordinate timelines and procurement touches.

I'll draft a short runbook with the exact API endpoints, tests to run, and how we'll capture metrics (Prometheus + logs export) and share by EOD. Any additional compliance docs you need for the VPC path, let me know.

- Aditya
